mapper.select: select doc->'org'->>'type' type, (doc->'settings'->'acct')::text acct from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}

insert into learner_accounts (tenant_id, kind, login, nickname, student_no, dept, status, minor, mkt) values (#{tid}, 'learner', #{login}, #{nick}, #{stu}, #{dept}, #{st}, #{minor}, #{mkt}) returning learner_id::text
mapper.update: update learner_accounts set status = 'withdrawn', nickname = '탈퇴 회원', withdrawn_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid)
update learner_accounts set status = 'active' where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid) and status = 'guardian_pending'
mapper.select: select status from learner_accounts where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid)
select learner_id::text learner_id, kind, login, nickname, student_no, dept, status, minor, idv_ok, mkt from learner_accounts where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id::text = #{sid}
mapper.update: update learner_accounts set status = 'withdrawn', nickname = '탈퇴 회원', student_no = null, dept = '', mkt = false, withdrawn_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid)
update learner_accounts set idv_ok = true where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid)
mapper.select: select learner_id::text learner_id, kind, login, nickname, student_no, dept, status, minor, idv_ok, to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', ) created_at from learner_accounts where tenant_id = #{tid} and status <> 'withdrawn' order by learner_accounts.created_at desc limit 5000
mapper.update: update learner_accounts set status = 'withdrawn', nickname = '탈퇴 회원', withdrawn_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid) and status = 'guardian_pending'
mapper.insert: insert into pii.otp (tid, bidx, purpose, code_hash, tries, expires_at) values (#{tid}, #{b}, #{purpose}, #{hash}, 0, now() + interval '10 minutes') on conflict (tid, bidx, purpose) do update set code_hash = excluded.code_hash, tries = 0, expires_at = excluded.expires_at
mapper.select: select code_hash, tries, (extract(epoch from expires_at) * 1000)::bigint exp_ms from pii.otp where tid = #{tid} and bidx = #{b} and purpose = #{purpose}
mapper.update: update pii.otp set tries = tries + 1 where tid = #{tid} and bidx = #{b} and purpose = #{purpose}
mapper.delete: delete from pii.otp where tid = #{tid} and bidx = #{b} and purpose = #{purpose}
delete from pii.otp where tid = #{tid} and bidx = #{b}
delete from pii.otp where tid = #{tid} and expires_at < now()
mapper.insert: insert into pii.identity (tid, learner_id, provider, provider_sub_hash, email_bidx, email_enc, email_mask, pw_hash, consent) values (#{tid}, cast(#{lid} as uuid), #{provider}, #{sub}, #{ebidx}, #{eenc}, #{emask}, #{pw}, cast(#{consent} as jsonb))
insert into pii.guardian (tid, learner_id, contact_enc, token_hash, expires_at) values (#{tid}, cast(#{lid} as uuid), #{contact}, #{th}, now() + interval '7 days')
insert into pii.access_log (tid, actor, action, learner_id, purpose, fields) values (#{tid}, #{actor}, #{action}, cast(#{lid} as uuid), #{purpose}, string_to_array(#{fields}, ','))
mapper.select: select id::text id, learner_id::text learner_id from pii.guardian where tid = #{tid} and token_hash = #{th} and status = 'pending' and expires_at > now()
mapper.delete: delete from pii.guardian where id = cast(#{id} as uuid)
delete from pii.guardian where tid = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid)
delete from pii.identity where tid = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid)
mapper.update: update pii.guardian set status = 'ok', confirmed_at = now() where id = cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.select: select learner_id::text learner_id, pw_hash from pii.identity where tid = #{tid} and email_bidx = #{e}
select learner_id::text from pii.identity where tid = #{tid} and provider = #{prov} and provider_sub_hash = #{sub}
select learner_id::text learner_id, pw_hash from pii.identity where tid = #{tid} and provider = 'univ' and provider_sub_hash = #{sub}

select learner_id::text learner_id, provider, email_enc, phone_enc, name_enc, consent::text consent, to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', ) created_at from pii.identity where tid = #{tid} and learner_id::text = #{sid}
update pii.identity set ${f}_enc = #{v} where tid = #{tid} and learner_id::text = #{sid} returning learner_id::text
select email_bidx from pii.identity where tid = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid)
select learner_id::text learner_id, email_mask from pii.identity where tid = #{tid}
select ${f}_enc v from pii.identity where tid = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{lid} as uuid)

select to_char(l.at at time zone 'UTC', ) at, l.actor, l.action, l.learner_id::text learner_id, l.purpose, array_to_json(l.fields)::text fields from pii.access_log l where l.tid = #{tid} order by l.at desc, l.id desc limit 300
delete from pii.guardian where tid = #{tid} and status = 'pending' and expires_at < now() returning learner_id::text
mapper.insert: insert into learner_sessions (id, tenant_id, sid, expires_at) values (#{id}, #{tid}, #{sid}, now() + interval '30 days')
mapper.delete: delete from learner_sessions where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
delete from sessions where expires_at < now()
delete from learner_sessions where expires_at < now()
